camel_example: aliyun esa CreateOriginRule --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 340035003106221 --Follow302MaxTries 1 --RuleEnable on --OriginHttpsPort 4433 --Follow302RetainArgs on --OriginScheme http --Sequence 1 --Follow302RetainHeader on --Range on --RangeChunkSize 1MB --OriginReadTimeout 10 --OriginHost 'origin.example.com' --OriginHttpPort 8080 --OriginMtls on --Follow302TargetHost 'test.com' --OriginSni 'origin.example.com' --Rule 'http.host_eq_video.example.com' --DnsRecord 'test.example.com' --Follow302Enable on --SiteVersion 1 --RuleName rule_example --OriginVerify on
description_en: Create a Back-to-Origin Rule for a Site
description_zh: 新增站点回源规则配置
kebab_example: aliyun esa create-origin-rule --site-id 340035003106221 --site-version 1 --rule-name rule_example --rule-enable on --rule http.host_eq_video.example.com --origin-host origin.example.com --origin-scheme http --origin-sni origin.example.com --dns-record test.example.com --origin-http-port 8080 --origin-https-port 4433 --range on --origin-mtls on --origin-verify on --range-chunk-size 1MB --sequence 1 --origin-read-timeout 10 --follow-302-enable on --follow-302-max-tries 1 --follow-302-retain-args on --follow-302-retain-header on --follow-302-target-host test.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateOriginRule

parameters.help_en: The ID of the site. You can obtain this ID by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: For sites with version management enabled, this specifies the version to which the configuration applies. The default value is 0
parameters.help_zh: 站点配置的版本号。开启了配置版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0
parameters.name: site_version

parameters.help_en: The rule name. Not required when creating a Global Configuration
parameters.help_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the rule. Not required when creating a Global Configuration. Valid values:

- `on`: Enables the rule.

- `off`: Disables the rule
parameters.help_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭
parameters.name: rule_enable

parameters.help_en:
The content of the rule, a Conditional Expression that matches user requests. Not required when creating a Global Configuration. There are two scenarios:

- To match all incoming requests, set the value to `true`.

- To match specific requests, set the value to a custom expression. Example: `(http.host eq "video.example.com")`
parameters.help_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
- 匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true。
- 匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
parameters.name: rule

parameters.help_en: The `Host` header to use in Origin requests
parameters.help_zh: 回源请求中携带的HOST
parameters.name: origin_host

parameters.help_en:
The protocol for Origin requests. Valid values:

- `http`: Uses the HTTP protocol.

- `https`: Uses the HTTPS protocol.

- `follow`: Uses the same protocol as the client request
parameters.help_zh:
回源请求使用的协议。取值范围：
- http：使用HTTP协议回源。
- https：使用HTTPS协议回源。
- follow：跟随客户端协议回源
parameters.name: origin_scheme

parameters.help_en: The Server Name Indication (SNI) to use in Origin requests
parameters.help_zh: 回源请求中携带的SNI
parameters.name: origin_sni

parameters.help_en: Overrides the DNS Record for Origin requests
parameters.help_zh: 改写回源请求的DNS解析记录
parameters.name: dns_record

parameters.help_en: The Origin Port to use for HTTP Origin requests
parameters.help_zh: 使用HTTP协议回源时访问的源站端口
parameters.name: origin_http_port

parameters.help_en: The Origin Port to use for HTTPS Origin requests
parameters.help_zh: 使用HTTPS协议回源时访问的源站端口
parameters.name: origin_https_port

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use range requests to download files from the Origin. Valid values:

- `on`: Enables range requests.

- `off`: Disables range requests.

- `force`: Forces range requests
parameters.help_zh:
使用range分片方式回源下载文件。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭。
- force：强制
parameters.name: range

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable mutual Transport Layer Security (mTLS) for Origin connections. Valid values:

- `on`: Enables mTLS.

- `off`: Disables mTLS
parameters.help_zh:
mtls开关。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭
parameters.name: origin_mtls

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable Origin Certificate Verification. Valid values:

- `on`: Enables verification.

- `off`: Disables verification
parameters.help_zh:
源站证书校验开关。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭
parameters.name: origin_verify

parameters.help_en:
The size of each chunk for range requests. Valid values:

- `512KB`

- `1MB`

- `2MB`

- `4MB`
parameters.help_zh:
range分片大小。取值范围：
- 512KB
- 1MB
- 2MB
- 4MB
parameters.name: range_chunk_size

parameters.help_en: The priority of the rule. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
parameters.help_zh: 规则执行顺序，数值越小越优先执行
parameters.name: sequence

parameters.help_en: The Origin read timeout in seconds
parameters.help_zh: 源站读超时时间(秒)
parameters.name: origin_read_timeout

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to follow 302 redirects from the Origin. Valid values:

- `on`: Enables following redirects.

- `off`: Disables following redirects
parameters.help_zh:
回源302跟随开关。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭
parameters.name: follow_302_enable

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of 302 redirects to follow. Valid range: 1 to 5
parameters.help_zh: 302跟随次数上限，取值范围[1-5]
parameters.name: follow_302_max_tries

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to retain the original request parameters when following a 302 redirect. Valid values:

- `on`: Retains the request parameters.

- `off`: Does not retain the request parameters
parameters.help_zh:
保留原始请求参数开关。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭
parameters.name: follow_302_retain_args

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to retain the original request header when following a 302 redirect. Valid values:

- `on`: Retains the request header.

- `off`: Does not retain the request header
parameters.help_zh:
保留原始请求头开关。取值范围：
- on：开启。
- off：关闭
parameters.name: follow_302_retain_header

parameters.help_en: The Origin `Host` header to use after a 302 redirect
parameters.help_zh: 修改302后的回源host
parameters.name: follow_302_target_host
